description: A time card calculator for hours worked, breaks and overtime across a week. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

overtimeAfter.description: Weekly hours after which the remaining hours count as overtime. Omitted means no overtime is worked out.

overtimeMultiplier.description: What overtime hours are paid at, as a multiple of rate: 1.5 is the usual. Only matters when overtimeAfter and rate are set; defaults to 1.

rate.description: Pay per hour. Omit it and the result gives hours only, with pay as null.

shifts.description: The shifts to total, one entry each. A shift ending before it starts is read as crossing midnight, never as negative.

breakMinutes.description: Unpaid break in minutes, taken off the shift. Must be shorter than the shift itself. Defaults to 0.

end.description: Clock-out time, in the same forms as start. Earlier than start means the shift ran past midnight; 24:00 is accepted as the end of the day.

label.description: A free-form name for the shift, such as a weekday or a date. Returned unchanged on the matching day in the result.

start.description: Clock-in time. Forgiving: "9:00", "9.00", "0900", "9am" and "9" all read the same.

name: time_card_calculator
title: Time Card Calculator
